messages.subject: Dubai Executive Profile | Energy, Commodities, ESG & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Joe,

HW Anderson's Dubai executive-search platform and its coverage across commodities, energy-transition products, metals and mining make this a focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where responsible growth, institutional trust and cross-border execution are central to performance. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
